label: main season
summary: Recommend further non-technical survey. The two visits did not reach or observe the area interior, and the informants recorded do not know its land use or history. There is neither a clearance target established in the evidence log nor sufficient reliable evidence of safe use to meet cancellation criteria. The nearest recorded accident is within 1 km, not stated to be inside this area.
flags: On a further visit, seek access to the area interior if feasible and identify people with first-hand knowledge of its use and history; the present informants cannot support cancellation.
The zone survey flag and zone priority are survey-planning information, not evidence about EO in the area.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: The people at the community meeting had moved to the vereda in the last 2 years and could not say how the area was used before.
E1.note: These recent arrivals explicitly lack knowledge of prior land use, so their statement neither indicates EO nor supports safe use of the area.

E2.quote: The survey team could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E2.note: The team's observation confirms that it could not inspect the interior; inaccessible land provides no evidence either way.

E3.quote: A bus driver said he only passes along the road at the edge of the area and does not know the land inside it.
E3.note: The driver expressly lacks knowledge of the land inside and offers no report about EO or safe use there.

E4.quote: The survey team could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E4.note: On visit 2 the team again could not inspect the interior, so this is not evidence of absence or presence.
